Requires example data under an open licence with SOURCE.md, but the canonical datasets for most listed candidates (synthetic control: Prop 99, Basque, West Germany) sit on hosts the cloud proxy refuses (data.cdc.gov, dataverse.harvard.edu, cran); a note on which mirrors work (pysyncon's GitHub data/ was reachable) would save a probe round.

deviations.result: Tests reproduce the paper's donor set and pysyncon's R-pinned weights on it, which indirectly checks the file.

notes: Explore idea: synthetic-control, sixth 'research algorithms as tools' venture (Abadie & Gardeazabal 2003; ADH 2010, 2015). Engine: exact primal active-set simplex QP for W, Nelder-Mead with SciPy defaults for V (nested / CV / equal), placebo-in-space with 20/5/2x screen, leave-one-out with a fit-aware sign-flip sentence. Verification: node --test 37/37; ADH 2015 West Germany CV weights within 0.01 of pysyncon 1.7.0 (R-Synth parity), path within 0.5%, ATT -1554.9 vs -1555.13; nested/outcome-only objectives at or below pysyncon's SLSQP (13,396 vs 14,765; 5,522 vs 5,627); QP = brute force on 200 random problems; Chromium smoke test clean, 390 px no overflow; optout-persistence count 1313->1314 passes. Finding for the post: placebo p-value on the example runs 0.059 / 0.083 / 0.333 / 1.0 for no screen / 20x / 5x / 2x. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README and research-tools README carry what the next run needs. Local run_workflow_locally --for-changes: every run: step passed; site-build steps UNRUN (needs ${{ }} expressions), GitHub CI had runners and was used as the verdict.
